description: This PHP class 'TimesheetColumn' models a data transfer object (DTO) for representing a timesheet column, including its date and a total value. It provides methods for retrieving and incrementing the total, as well as accessing the date.

classes.name: TimesheetColumn
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a timesheet column with a specific date and total hours.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TimesheetColumn with a specific date.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with this timesheet column.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total hours or value accumulated.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total by a specified amount and returns the new total.
